title: Salivary adjunct tests to determine the need for biopsy for early detection of oral squamous cell carcinoma and potentially malignant disorders
html: Salivary adjunct tests could play a role in the oral cancer diagnostic pathway before a biopsy-confirmed definitive diagnosis. The authors aimed to assess the diagnostic impact and diagnostic test accuracy of salivary adjunct tests for detecting oral potentially malignant disorders and oral squamous cell carcinoma.
